title: Tableau / Data Visualisation Analyst
text: Tableau / Data Visualisation Analyst at Alloc8 (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). The Company: Alloc8 present an opportunity to work with one of Australia's most well respected organisations. As recruiters Alloc8 have been providing talent across IM and BI for over ten years and continue to work with only the best companies in the market. This client is no exception and over the years it has carved out a reputation for being reliable, innovative and a real thought leader within this domain. With ongoing sponsorship and investment the Data Visualisation space is really hotting up About You: They are currently looking to employ a Senior Tableau developer who can help drive information empowerment back to the business through the use of Tableau Reporting and Dashboards. To be considered we are looking for people with the following attributes: At least 5 years experience delivering Business Intelligence and / or Visualisation Solutions. Previous consulting and customer engagement skills. Proven ability in delivering Tableau Solutions across Tableau Desktop and Server. A deep understanding of the presentation layer with Business Intelligence and the ability to help customers realise the benefits of Tableau from a presentation and dashboarding perspective. Strong SQL skills with core SQL programming experience. Outstanding communication and customer engagement skills with a proven track record working with business users. The ability to drive change and innovate within a BI / Tableau environment. Confidence in the design, implementation, configuration and support of the Tableau technology stack. Previous Business Analysis skills. Tableau certification would make your applications a particularly strong one! In return for this unique skills set my client are offering the opportunity to work on some cutting edge technology platforms, real progression, on - going training and a great work culture. Due to the nature of this role only applications from Australian Residents or Citizens can be entertained.
